snippet.title: President Simulator - Demo out now!
snippet.description:
You want to become the next US President? Do you think you'll do better than the current one? 

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3705900/President_Simulator/?utm_source=youtube&utm_content=trailer1

Become President of the USA: sign absurd decrees and balance your policies to avoid being called a "sellout." Communicate to gain popularity, manage interviews, and face press conferences. Everything falling apart? Press the red button.

For more info and updates:
💬Discord: https://discord.gg/2hZCFbRw
🐦X/Twitter: https://x.com/PotusSimGame
🎵  Tiktok:  https://www.tiktok.com/@president_simulator

Credits: 
- Developers: Studio 14b (Guillaume CAZELLES / Pierre GRIMAULT)
